prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: revised Kalistar narrative fantasy card illustration ONLY, portrait 4:5, no card frame or text.
Input image 1 is the edit target and strict character/scene reference: Kaylis fencing in the stone practice ground. Images 2 and 3 are ONLY painterly art direction references, Momo and Valazar; do not borrow their characters, environments, colours or objects.
Repaint the target as a cohesive finished illustration, never a pasted collage, recolour filter or detached overlays. Keep the SAME recognisable adult Kaylis: warm brown skin, delicate freckles, beautiful expressive face, dark eyes, athletic build, confident engaged smile and focused gaze during her flowing fencing footwork. Make her strikingly beautiful through natural facial harmony and expressive light, not glamour posing, airbrushing or an unrelated celebrity face.
User changes: her flowing tailored trousers are now rich BLACK cloth, naturally painted with convincing folds, charcoal highlights and material depth, not grey/white, not leggings. Preserve the black sleeveless high-neck top, bare tattooed arms and black boots. Replace the large loose curly ponytail with beautifully executed close-to-scalp cornrow braids sweeping backwards, some deliberately relaxed texture and a few fine loose curls, gathered into a soft loosely assembled braided bun at the BACK of her head. The scalp braid pattern should read clearly; the bun must not become a huge high ponytail. Preserve her existing face and identity.
Composition: RE-CENTRE KAYLIS herself, not merely the whole scene including the sword. Her face around x49%, torso/waist x49-52%, weight-bearing leg near the middle. Show her entire head and both boots with comfortable margin. Her silhouette must feel centered between two later card statistic rails. Keep her face, hands, forearms, sword hilt and complete blade visibly inside the central 20%-81% of the illustration width; the extreme side strips will be masked by the card. Recompose anatomy and negative space naturally as needed, without awkward stretching or moving detached limbs. Keep the dynamic graceful fencing action; body turning and active feet, not a posed fashion photograph.
Weapon: preserve ONE elegant long narrow steel fencing blade with coherent round guard, grip and hand anatomy. Hilt, metal blade and pointed tip follow a single perfectly straight credible line, pointing upwards into the open central-right sky with tip inside x76% / y12%, fully visible and clear of the future right rail. Do not add another weapon.
Magic: strengthen the beautiful RAINBOW incandescence of her existing flowing arm tattoos. Bright fine molten cores within the tattoo lines, nuanced spectral transitions, warm/cool coloured reflected light on her skin and edges of the black clothes. A small amount of luminous rainbow energy flows convincingly from the tattooed sword hand through the guard, curling closely along BOTH edges of the blade, with a few fine ember flecks. Keep the straight steel blade clearly readable beneath the light, not a thick neon tube or lightsaber. This is controlled incandescence, not fire covering the face or a cloud of overwhelming VFX. Keep the tattoo motif, flesh volume, natural fingers and fencing silhouette legible at card size.
Invariants: same stone practice ground built by Balmhyr in the red/grey canyon, calm blue sky and limited distant canyon shapes, no other character and no Balmhyr shown; maintain the same time of day and motivated sunlight. Maintain Kalistar DA: painterly narrative fantasy, visible sculpted brushstrokes, varied painted planes, worn tactile stone/cloth/metal, human emotion, non-manga face. No photorealism, glossy 3D, anime, chibi, smooth plastic skin, oversharpened textures, excessive debris, text, logos, statistics or frame. The output is the full revised illustration only.
